title: Zephyr: TOFU key pinning on first contact
notes: Implemented bounded, mutex-serialized TOFU persistence in coap_keys_store: backend-neutral load/save callbacks, validated boot restore, monotonic revisions, canonical SHA-512 pubkey-to-IID verification before pinning, first-contact durable commit-before-publish, idempotent match, mismatch rejection, and rollback on persistence failure. Persistence is also applied atomically to existing put/delete/touch mutations once initialized. Corrected Zephyr pubkey_to_iid to the controlling SHA-512/U-L-bit algorithm. Added focused shared-vector, reboot, corruption, save-failure, mismatch-before-write, and concurrent first-contact tests. Scoped nRF52840 Zephyr compile passed for coap_keys_store.c, coap_keys_format.c, and tests/coap_keys/src/main.c; git diff --check passed. Full image compilation is presently blocked outside this leaf by existing dirty coap_status.c CONFIG_COAP_SERVER_MESSAGE_SIZE static assertions. Platform Settings/NVS lifecycle binding is separated as discovered follow-up project-LICHEN-worker6-l1qw.6.6.2.8 because coap/Kconfig is concurrently owned.
